style_authority.note: Resolves the stated adaptive product and honors shared semantic authority with platform-native divergence.

reference_selection.note: Applies native iOS, Android, adaptive and validation concepts; exact reference reads are not independently established by the retained final output and manifest.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Focuses on native navigation, scalable type, reachability and window structure rather than decorative styling.

evidence_level.note: Labels L0 prompt-only review and distinguishes manual routing from an unexecuted planner; no build or runtime pass claimed.

verified_boundary.note: Separates supplied facts and numerical deductions from source, accessibility, rendering, recovery and device behavior that remain unverified.

design_moves.note: Eight concrete moves and a detailed parity matrix address all main defects. Android Remove animations permits a fade as an option instead of requiring immediate state under fully disabled animations.

scope_control.note: 64 lines, five blockers and eight moves; recovery suggestions support the explicit interruption-preservation product requirement.
